visual_action: The video is a montage celebrating Jimmy Carter's 100th birthday. It opens with a clip of a younger Carter speaking at a podium. It then cuts to a series of historical photos and video clips from his life and career, including him and his wife Rosalynn waving from a plane, campaigning in crowds, interacting with supporters, sitting at a picnic, and shaking hands. One family photo shows him, Rosalynn, and their daughter Amy with a colorful, hand-drawn style rainbow graphic overlaid behind them. The montage continues with footage from campaign rallies, him hugging his wife on stage, waving from a train, a black and white photo of him next to a Habitat for Humanity sign, and a final shot of him blowing out candles on a large birthday cake.

cast.name: Jimmy Carter
cast.evidence: The entire video is a tribute to him, featuring him in every scene. The on-screen text reads 'Happy 100th birthday, President Carter!' and he introduces himself at the start of the video, saying, 'My name is Jimmy Carter.'

cast.name: Rosalynn Carter
cast.evidence: She is shown in multiple historical clips alongside Jimmy Carter, including waving from a plane, in a family photo, and hugging him on stage.

cast.name: Amy Carter
cast.evidence: She appears as a young girl in a family photograph alongside Jimmy and Rosalynn Carter.

spoken_summary: The video begins with a soundbite of Jimmy Carter saying, 'My name is Jimmy Carter, and I'm running for president,' followed by the sound of a cheering crowd. The rest of the video features the song 'Footloose' by Kenny Loggins, with the lyric 'been working so hard' being audible near the end.
audio_music: The video opens with a spoken line from Jimmy Carter and crowd applause. At around the 4-second mark, the upbeat and energetic 80s pop-rock track 'Footloose' by Kenny Loggins begins and plays throughout the rest of the montage, creating a celebratory and nostalgic mood.
editing_pacing: A fast-paced montage of historical photos and video clips.
central_claim: The post celebrates former President Jimmy Carter's life and political legacy on the occasion of his 100th birthday.
intended_effect: To evoke feelings of respect and nostalgia for Jimmy Carter and to encourage viewers to celebrate his milestone birthday.
